page_title: HEI 1-1 MON | Heidenheim v B. Monchengladbach 16/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+5' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
90+5' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) takes the corner which is cleared.
90+2' Referee Martin Petersen halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Frank Schmidt, then shows him a yellow.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
88' Frank Schmidt has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Florian Pick (Heidenheim) replacing Eren Dinkci.
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Tim Kleindienst departs the field of play to be replaced by Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim).
87' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) takes the corner but it's cleared.
85' The attendance is 15000.
84' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play.
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Manu Kone (B. Monchengladbach) comes onto the pitch for Rocco Reitz.
82' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
80' Martin Petersen blows his whistle. Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) commits a foul after dangerous play.
76' Gerardo Seoane prepares a substitution. Stefan Lainer is replaced by Marvin Friedrich (B. Monchengladbach).
76' The manager makes a subsitution with Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) coming on for Franck Honorat.
75' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
75' A corner kick by Heidenheim is thwarted by the well prepared Moritz Nicolas (B. Monchengladbach).
74' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) rises high to connect with a cross from the corner kick, but his powerful header from center of the box hits the left post!
74' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
71' Gerardo Seoane has decided to make a change. Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) replaces Jordan Siebatcheu.
71' Substitution. Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) on for Florian Neuhaus.
66' 1 - 1 Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and curls the ball into the top left corner in trademark fashion.
64' Maximilian Wober (B. Monchengladbach) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
62' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Heidenheim comes to nothing.
61' Heidenheim take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
60' The resulting corner from Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) comes to nothing.
59' Kevin Sessa (Heidenheim) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
59' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) storms into the middle of the box and connects with a smart cross from Eren Dinkci, the keeper is helpless but the header flies just over the bar.
58' A poorly executed mid-range free kick by Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) as he fails to deliver a decent cross.
58' Dangerous play by Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim). Martin Petersen blows his whistle for a foul.
54' Heidenheim can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
54' Heidenheim failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
51' The game is interrupted. Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
50' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
48' Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Martin Petersen saw the whole situation.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Frank Schmidt gives a chance to Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) and Tim Siersleben is off.
46' Frank Schmidt makes a switch. Kevin Sessa (Heidenheim) is coming on in place of Nikola Dovedan at the start of the second period.
46' The game is over for Omar Haktab Traore. Marnon Busch (Heidenheim) comes on for the second half.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' Referee Martin Petersen has finally had enough of Gerardo Seoane and brandishes a yellow card at him!
45+4' Martin Petersen has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' VAR review of the penalty decision hasn’t taken long and it’s NO PENALTY! The Heidenheim players are stunned.
45+1' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Heidenheim using VAR. Let's see what happens.

45+1' Nico Elvedi (B. Monchengladbach) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Martin Petersen blows his whistle for an infringement. The referee makes the call - penalty to Heidenheim!
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.
40' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches over the top.
36' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
36' Martin Petersen has a clear sight and sees a foul from Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim).
34' Poor challenge! Tim Siersleben (Heidenheim) is penalised for tripping and Martin Petersen blows his whistle.
33' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
33' Martin Petersen couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) and blew his whistle.
31' Nikola Dovedan (Heidenheim) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Martin Petersen no option but to blow his whistle.
30' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
28' Jordan Siebatcheu (B. Monchengladbach) commits a rough challenge and Martin Petersen blows his whistle for a foul.
28' Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play.
27' Tim Siersleben (Heidenheim) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Martin Petersen blows his whistle for a foul.
26' Kevin Muller makes a brilliant save! Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) met a rebound outside the box and attempted to beat the keeper low into the middle of the goal.
22' Although Christoph Kramer (B. Monchengladbach) is just on the bench, Martin Petersen has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
18' Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
12' Rough tackle by Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
11' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
11' Stefan Lainer (B. Monchengladbach) commits a rough foul. Martin Petersen stops the game and makes a call.
9' 0 - 1 Goal! Jordan Siebatcheu provides Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort into the bottom left corner. 0:1.
1' Tim Siersleben (Heidenheim) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Heidenheim will kick the game off.
